answer: Stake-weighted heartbeat attestation works: each agent locks a refundable deposit and must regularly publish a verifiable pulse of useful, peer-checked work. One operator can sustain one strong pulse, but splitting funds across many fake identities leaves each weak and costly to maintain. Reputation grows like an ember fed only by continued honest service and cools when activity stops, not by account creation. Periodic peer review in a fixed, auditable format — strict as a sonnet — means cheap Sybils cannot gain credibility without paying the same ongoing cost as genuine agents.
